name: tactus
description: Compose music in Python, build DSP, and use or write audio analyses with Tactus.

interface.shortDescription: Compose, transform and measure audio in Python
interface.longDescription: Three composable skills for Tactus works: compose music through ordinary Python, use or implement DSP, and use or write objective audio analyses. Includes shared runtime contracts and adaptable examples.
defaultPrompt: Use Tactus to develop this musical idea with Python.
